sequence_scopes.sequence_heading: 3.3.5 FAN COIL UNIT WITH HEATING AND COOLING COILS - OCCUPIED SPACE

assertions.expected: THE SUPPLY FAN SHALL BE ENABLED (SYS-ENA) AND COMMANDED TO RUN (SF-SS). FAN SHALL RUN AT LOW SPEED (30% OF MAX AIRFLOW)
WHEN ZN-T DROPS BELOW ZN-T-LL (WITH A 2 DEGREES F DEADBAND) RAMP FAN TO HEATING SPEED AND ENABLE THE HEATING COIL TEMPERATURE CONTROL LOOP. DISABLE THE COOLING COIL CONTROL LOOPS
WHEN ZN-T RISES ABOVE ZN-T-HL (WITH A 2 DEGREES F DEADBAND) RAMP FAN TO COOLING SPEED AND ENABLE THE COOLING COIL TEMPERATURE CONTROL LOOP. DISABLE THE HEATING COIL CONTROL LOOPS
FAILURE OF ANY PROOF OR ACTIVATION OF ANY SAFETY RESULT IN ALL CONTROL LOOPS BEING DISABLED AND THE FAN COIL UNIT FAN BEING COMMANDED OFF UNTIL RESET
DDC HARDWARE RESET OF ALL PROOFS AND SAFETIES SHALL BE VIA A LOCAL BINARY PUSH-BUTTON (RST-BUT) INPUT TO THE DDC HARDWARE, VIA A REMOTE COMMAND TO THE DDC HARDWARE

DDC HARDWARE SHALL MODULATE THE HEATING COIL CONTROL VALVE TO MAINTAIN ZONE TEMPERATURE (ZN-T) AT SETPOINT (ZN-T-SP) AS SHOWN. WHEN THIS LOOP IS DISABLED, THE HEATING COIL CONTROL VALVE SHALL BE CLOSED

DDC HARDWARE SHALL MODULATE THE COOLING COIL CONTROL VALVE TO MAINTAIN ZONE TEMPERATURE (ZN-T) AT SETPOINT (ZN-T-SP) AS SHOWN. WHEN THIS LOOP IS DISABLED, THE COOLING COIL CONTROL VALVE SHALL BE CLOSED
DUTY UNIT FAILURE SHALL BE DUE TO FAN FAILURE OR HIGH/LOW TEMPERATURE FOR 15 MINUTES, OR HIGH CONDENSATE LEVEL. THE STANDBY UNIT SHALL BE ENERGIZED AND SHALL BECOME THE DUTY UNIT
FCU-T6, FCU-T8, FCU-T9, FCU-T10, FCU-T11 ONLY UPON RECIEVING SIGNAL FROM DDC DISABLE COOLING MODE UNTIL FAILED CHILLER IS RESTORED TO SERVICE
IN THE EVENT OF ASSOCIATED AHU FAILURE AS INDICATED BY DDC SYSTEM (SEE SPFVAV/FCU MATRIX), SPFVAV DAMPER SHALL CLOSE AND FAN COIL UNIT SHALL ENERGIZE
UPON ASSOCIATED AHU RESTORATION OF OPERATION AS INDICATED BY DDC SYSTEM, FAN COIL UNIT SHALL BE DE-ENERGIZED AND SPFVAV SHALL RESUME NORMAL OPERATION
EACH SUNDAY FROM 0000 TO 0200 HRS, THE SPFVAV DAMPER SHALL MODULATE TO MAINTAIN MINIMUM AIRFLOW AND THE FCU SHALL BE ENERGIZED TO PROVIDE SCHEDULED AIRFLOW
AT 0200 HRS, THE FCU SHALL BE DE-ENERIGZED AND THE SFPVAV SHALL RETURN TO NORMAL OPERATION

The source prints RECIEVING and DE-ENERIGZED in two asserted sequence statements; they are retained rather than silently corrected.
